concerns.text: FR-007 mandates: 'stratify permutation testing by study ID or batch... OR include batch as a covariate'. T029 implements stratification by genotype/study ID but lacks a task to implement the mandatory fallback: 'include batch as a covariate' if metadata is missing. T035 implements SVA (dimensionality reduction) instead of the spec's required covariate adjustment, leaving FR-007 unfulfilled.

SC-005 requires measuring computational feasibility against 6h/7GB limits. T040 only 'logs' runtime/memory. There is no task to explicitly parse these logs, compare against thresholds, and fail the pipeline or generate a formal 'Feasibility Report' artifact if limits are exceeded, as required by the success criteria.

FR-005 mandates exactly 1,000 permutation iterations. T029 describes implementing '1,000 permutation iterations' but lacks a specific task to enforce this as a hard constraint (e.g., parameter validation) or verify the count in output logs, risking implementation drift.

US-1 Acceptance Scenario 2 requires logging the categorical-to-ordinal mapping used. T012 implements the conversion but omits the explicit instruction to 'log the mapping used' in the task description, relying on implicit adherence which may be missed during implementation.

FR-004 requires outputting 'univariate correlation coefficients'. FR-006 requires filtering based on 'q-values' derived from p-values. T026 saves 'importance score, correlation coefficient' but does not explicitly require saving the unadjusted p-values, which are necessary to verify the BH correction logic described in FR-006.
